name: An t-Slighe Dìomhair
source:
Choose to play as Cedric (he/him), burdened by grief, or Eris (she/her), haunted by expectation. Each path refracts the forest’s horrors through a different lens of loneliness.

Will you follow the path? Or will the forest take you first?

[From [url=https://ayperosia.itch.io/the-secret-path]itch.io[/url]]
